raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fix a KV page ownership bug that can cause negative #full token and full token usage when DeepSeek V4 requests finish on Ascend with radix caching enabled.

Finished requests now use the insertion result to determine the FULL prefix owned by the radix tree.

## Root cause

The NPU DSV4 C128 cache stores complete compressed pages. With the default C128 page size of 16, the cacheable prefix is rounded down to a multiple of 2048 original tokens.

By the time a request finishes, SWA eviction may have advanced beyond that rounded endpoint. The FULL prefix is successfully inserted into the radix tree, but the subsequent prefix match can return a shorter prefix because the corresponding SWA window is unavailable.

Previously, checkpoint_into_tree() used this shorter match to update cache_protected_len. Request cleanup then returned FULL pages still owned by the tree to the allocator.

Those pages were counted as both free and evictable:

full_used = full_capacity - full_available - full_evictable

This produces negative usage and can allow pages still referenced by the radix tree to be reused.

For example, a 2304-token request with its first 2048 SWA tokens already evicted produced:

| State after request cleanup | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| FULL tokens retained by the tree | 2048 | 2048 |
| Tokens released by request cleanup | 2304 | 256 |
| Reported active FULL tokens | -2048 | 0 |

## Changes

- Use InsertResult.last_device_node as the ownership boundary when checkpointing finished requests.
- Add regression coverage for request lengths of 2048, 2176, 2304, and 4352 tokens, covering both reusable and unavailable SWA windows.
- Verify FULL/SWA capacity conservation and the absence of duplicate free pages after cache eviction.

## Validation

- Passed an isolated CPU source-level replay using production radix-tree and allocator code with dependency stubs.
- The regression failed on the original implementation in both unavailable-window cases and passed with the fix across all four cases.
- Additional replay cases reproduced FULL usage of -2048, -4096, and -34816 before the fix; each returned to 0 afterward.
- Ruff lint, formatting, Python AST parsing, and git diff --check passed.

The normal test-module invocation was blocked by local dependency incompatibilities. Ascend end-to-end validation and the AIME26 rerun are still pending.

To run the regression in a compatible environment:

python3 test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_dsv4_hicache_l2.py TestDSV4FinishedCheckpoint -v

Restart the server before end-to-end validation so the allocator starts with clean page ownership.

                 )

-        # With PD decode radix caching, SWA matching can stop short of the inserted path.
-        # Repoint from that path to protect all tree-owned KV.
-        new_last_node = result.last_device_node
+        if is_finished:
+            # The tree owns the inserted FULL prefix even if it is no longer
+            # reusable: e.g. C128 rounds the endpoint behind the live SWA
+            # window. A shorter match would make release_kv_cache free those
+            # tree-owned pages a second time.
+            new_last_node = result.last_device_node
+        else:
+            # A running request also needs the matched component state.
+            # Bypass session matching: this is the tree's own inserted prefix.
+            match_result = self._match_tree(MatchPrefixParams(key=radix_key, req=req))
+            new_last_node = match_result.last_device_node
         new_indices = self.path_device_indices(new_last_node)
         new_prefix_len = result.prefix_len
         assert req.kv.cache_protected_len <= len(new_indices) + self.page_size - 1, (

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 """Focused CPU contracts for DeepSeek V4 NPU HiCache L2."""
 
 import unittest
+from array import array
 from types import MethodType, SimpleNamespace
 from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
 
@@ -12,22 +13,134 @@
 from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_allocator import (
     DSV4NPUTokenToKVPoolAllocator,
 )
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ReqKvInfo
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator.swa import SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import EvictParams, MatchPrefixParams
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_swa_memory_pool import BaseSWAKVPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.cache_init_params import CacheInitParams
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, PoolTransfer
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache import hybrid_pool_assembler as assembler
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import ReqToTokenPool

     DeepSeekV4PagedHostPool,
     DeepSeekV4StateHostPool,
 )
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixKey
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components import (
     CacheTransferPhase,
     ComponentType,
 )
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_radix_cache import UnifiedRadixCache
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
 
+class TestDSV4FinishedCheckpoint(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_finished_request_keeps_full_pages_without_a_reusable_swa_window(self):
+        """A C128-aligned prefix can outlive its SWA window. Finishing must
+        leave its FULL pages owned by the tree until eviction, even on a miss.
+        """
+        page_size, capacity = 128, 8192
+        for length, expected_hit in ((2048, 2048), (2176, 2048), (2304, 0), (4352, 0)):
+            with self.subTest(length=length, expected_hit=expected_hit):
+                # Only KV buffers and the independent C128 page ownership are
+                # doubles; FULL/SWA allocation and the radix tree run on CPU.
+                kv_pool = MagicMock(spec=BaseSWAKVPool)
+                kv_pool.full_kv_pool = kv_pool.swa_kv_pool = None
+                kv_pool.swa_req_ring_size = None
+                allocator = SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator(
+                    capacity,
+                    capacity,
+                    page_size,
+                    torch.bfloat16,
+                    "cpu",
+                    kv_pool,
+                    need_sort=False,
+                )
+                kv_pool.full_to_swa_index_mapping = allocator.full_to_swa_index_mapping
+                kv_pool.translate_loc_from_full_to_swa.side_effect = lambda indices: (
+                    allocator.full_to_swa_index_mapping[indices.long()]
+                )
+                allocator.c128_attn_allocator = SimpleNamespace(
+                    page_size=16, free_pages=torch.arange(1, 5)
+                )
+                allocator.retain_c128_pages = MagicMock()
+                allocator.release_c128_pages = MagicMock()
+                pool = ReqToTokenPool(1, capacity, "cpu", enable_memory_saver=False)
+                pool.req_to_c128_sidecar = torch.arange(
+                    1, capacity // 2048 + 1, dtype=torch.int64
+                ).repeat(pool._alloc_size, 1)
+                pool.set_c128_prefix_pages = MagicMock()
+                cache = UnifiedRadixCache(
+                    CacheInitParams(
+                        disable=False,
+                        req_to_token_pool=pool,
+                        token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+                        page_size=page_size,
+                        sliding_window_size=128,
+                        tree_components=(
+                            ComponentType.FULL,
+                            ComponentType.SWA,
+                            ComponentType.C128,
+                        ),
+                        component_registry_override={
+                            ComponentType.C128: C128SidecarComponent
+                        },
+                        tree_core_backend="python",
+                    )
+                )
+                req = SimpleNamespace(
+                    rid="c128-rounded-finish",
+                    kv=ReqKvInfo(),
+                    origin_input_ids=array("q", range(length)),
+                    full_untruncated_fill_ids=array("q", range(length)),
+                    finished=lambda: True,
+                    priority=0,
+                    session_id=None,
+                    kv_rotation_base=None,
+                    extra_key=None,
+                    cache_salt=None,
+                    swa_branching_seqlen=None,
+                )
+                pool.alloc([req])
+                full = allocator.full_attn_allocator.alloc(length)
+                swa = allocator.swa_attn_allocator.alloc(length)
+                allocator.set_full_to_swa_mapping(full, swa)
+                pool.write((req.kv.req_pool_idx, slice(0, length)), full)
+                req.kv.kv_committed_len = req.kv.kv_allocated_len = length
+                req.last_node = cache.root_node_handle()
+                req.lock = cache.lock(req.last_node)
+                cached_len = length // 2048 * 2048
+                evicted_len = length - 256
+                allocator.free_swa_segment(full[:evicted_len], start_pos=0)
+                req.kv.set_evicted_seqlen(ComponentType.SWA, evicted_len)
+
+                # The checkpoint/free/unlock sequence used by release_kv_cache.
+                cache.checkpoint_into_tree(req, up_to=length)
+                cache.free_kv_row(req.kv, [(req.kv.cache_protected_len, length)])
+                cache.unlock(req.lock)
+
+                match = cache.match_prefix(
+                    MatchPrefixParams(key=RadixKey(array("q", range(length))))
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(match.device_prefix_len, expected_hit)
+                self.assertEqual(cache.full_evictable_size(), cached_len)
+                self.assertEqual(allocator.full_available_size(), capacity - cached_len)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    allocator.swa_available_size() + cache.swa_evictable_size(),
+                    capacity,
+                )
+
+                cache.evict(EvictParams(num_tokens=cached_len))
+                self.assertEqual(cache.full_evictable_size(), 0)
+                self.assertEqual(allocator.full_available_size(), capacity)
+                self.assertEqual(allocator.swa_available_size(), capacity)
+                pages = allocator.full_attn_allocator.get_all_free_pages()
+                self.assertEqual(pages.unique().numel(), pages.numel())
+
+
